title: ARA Reference Entry
description: Uniform shape for each entry listed under manifest.references.*. Producers used to write these free-form; this schema pins the fields consumers can rely on so cross-ARA diffs by content_hash become straightforward.

kind.description: Semantic tag for the referenced artifact. Common values: pareto_pool, repair_history, experiment_registry, review_state, critic_findings, claim_evidence_graph, manuscript_state, figure_spec, stage_standards, process_alignment, research_program, manuscript_candidate_pool, self_evolution, research_plan, idea_cards, pipeline_manifest, repair_attempts.

path.description: Path relative to the ARA root (e.g. pipeline/review_state.json).

schema_version.description: The producer's own version tag for this artifact, if any.

producer.description: Which pipeline stage or subsystem generated the artifact.
